Description: Universal quotes applicable to any industry

Quotes.Text: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
Quotes.Author: Aristotle

Quotes.Text: The bitterness of poor quality remains long after the sweetness of low price is forgotten.
Quotes.Author: Benjamin Franklin

Quotes.Text: Excellence is not a skill, it's an attitude.
Quotes.Author: Ralph Marston

Quotes.Text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
Quotes.Author: Steve Jobs

Quotes.Text: Customer service is not a department, it's everyone's job.
Quotes.Author: Anonymous

Quotes.Text: It takes 20 years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it.
Quotes.Author: Warren Buffett

Quotes.Text: The customer's perception is your reality.
Quotes.Author: Kate Zabriskie

Quotes.Text: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work.
Quotes.Author: Steve Jobs

Quotes.Text: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
Quotes.Author: Winston Churchill

Quotes.Text: The secret of success is to do the common thing uncommonly well.
Quotes.Author: John D. Rockefeller
